content.short: Mailchain is the communication layer for Web3.
content.description: Web3 identities currently lack private messaging and there is no native communication layer for the ecosystem. Mailchain provides an open-source messaging protocol and a single unified inbox that lets you privately email another Web3 identity or blockchain address. You can manage communications for all your identities across every protocol from one place, making private Web3 interactions simpler, more cohesive, and easier to access.
